cases.question: 各地区的 Support Plus 收入占本地区总收入的比例是多少？按比例从高到低列出。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN product = 'Support Plus' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS support_plus_revenue, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS region_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN product = 'Support Plus' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue_share_pct FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue_share_pct DESC

cases.question: 南部地区在2024年每个月销售了多少种不同产品、总销量和总收入？按月份排列。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS distinct_products, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE region = 'South' AND substr(order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY substr(order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY month

cases.question: 哪些岗位分布在最多的不同工作地点？列出全部岗位的地点数和员工人数并按地点数降序。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT role, COUNT(DISTINCT location) AS location_count, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees GROUP BY role ORDER BY location_count DESC, employee_count DESC, role

cases.question: 各部门绩效不低于4.5的员工占比和这些员工的平均薪资分别是多少？按占比降序。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT department, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN performance_score >= 4.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_performer_pct, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN performance_score >= 4.5 THEN salary END), 2) AS high_performer_avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY high_performer_pct DESC, department

cases.question: 各套餐中暂停状态客户的数量、MRR总额及其占套餐总MRR的比例是多少？按比例降序。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT plan, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Paused' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paused_customers, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Paused' THEN mrr ELSE 0 END), 2) AS paused_mrr, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Paused' THEN mrr ELSE 0 END) / SUM(mrr), 2) AS paused_mrr_share_pct FROM subscriptions GROUP BY plan ORDER BY paused_mrr_share_pct DESC, plan

cases.question: 哪个注册月份带来的新客户MRR总额最高？如果并列全部返回，并给出客户数。
cases.oracle_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT substr(signup_date, 1, 7) AS signup_month, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, SUM(mrr) AS total_mrr FROM subscriptions GROUP BY substr(signup_date, 1, 7)), ranked AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_mrr DESC) AS rnk FROM monthly) SELECT signup_month, customer_count, ROUND(total_mrr, 2) AS total_mrr FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY signup_month

cases.question: 每个产品类别中销量最高的具体产品是什么？并列时全部返回，并给出销量。
cases.oracle_sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT p.category, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category, p.product_name), ranked AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS rnk FROM grouped) SELECT category, product_name, total_quantity FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY category, product_name

cases.question: 不同客户分群和销售渠道组合的订单数及每单平均收入是多少？按订单数降序列出。
cases.oracle_sql: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.segment, o.sales_channel, SUM(oi.line_revenue) AS order_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id, c.segment, o.sales_channel) SELECT segment, sales_channel, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(order_revenue), 2) AS avg_order_revenue FROM order_totals GROUP BY segment, sales_channel ORDER BY order_count DESC, segment, sales_channel

高流失风险是否集中在特定薪资区间？识别最突出的区间后，继续比较其中的岗位和部门。禁止个人明细。

订单状态是否与支付方式存在明显关联？先识别最异常的组合，再调查销售渠道和城市构成。
